title.description: The tab's and the navigator's words; default the name.

intent.description: What the view answers, in the user's words ("the machine now"): an intent finds it.

space.description: The navigator's space that lists it: machine, work or agents.

columns.description:
table: the field of each cell (required; `a.b` is a field of a field, `a|b` the first that is not null); list: the
fields of an object item.

labels.description:
The words of a column's header (`{"result.label": "Kind"}`) and of a button's label (`{"give-windows": "Give it
to Windows"}`).

formats.description:
How a column's or a stat's value shows: `ago`, `time` (seconds since the epoch), `int`, `1dp`, `count` (an
array's length), `join` (an array or object's values with " / ").

group.description: table and list: rows in groups, each with its count.

levels.description: table: the state colours of number columns.

filter.description: table and list: only the rows whose fields have these values.

last.description: table and list: only the last this many rows, newest first.

max.description: gauge: the value of a full gauge (default 100).

unit.description: stat: the unit after the value.

warn.description: stat: the limits of its state colour.

note.description: stat: the line under the value; `{field}` is a value of the source's whole answer.

missing.description: stat: the text when the value is missing: its cause, with `{field}` of the answer.

trend.description: stat: a path of the answer to an array of numbers: the trend under the value.

x.description: chart: the x field (seconds since the epoch show as times), the y field, and the series field.

row_actions.description: table and list: buttons of each row.

oneOf.description: An array of objects: one row each, one cell for each of `columns`.
Any JSON value as indented rows.
An array: one row each (the fields of `columns` for an object).
Other views, top to bottom: by name, or inline.
One value with its unit, its state against `warn` and `critical`, a note and a trend.

An array of objects as lines over time: `x` (seconds since the epoch, or any number), `y`, one chart per value
of `series` (a chart never mixes kinds), with axes.

Source.description: Where a view reads its data.

op.description: A read operation, by its dotted name (`thread.show`).

input.description:
The operation's input; `{param}` in a string is the parameter's value (a whole `"{param}"` of an integer
parameter is the number).

path.description:
The part of the answer to show: `$`, or `$.field.0.field` (a number is an array index; `[field=value]` is the
first item of an array whose field has that value).

all.description: The operation answers in pages (`items`, `next`): read every page; the answer is `{items}`.

Group.description: Rows in groups: by a field's value, or by rules on a row's text (the first rule that matches).

field.description: The field whose value is the group.

rules.description: Rules on the row's text (a string row, or the field's value): the group of the first rule that matches.

rest.description: The group of a row that no rule matches.

labels.description: The words of a group value (`{"vm": "Virtual machines"}`).

order.description: The groups first in this order; others after them.

fold.description: A group with more rows than this starts folded (its count shows).

any.description: The text has one of these words (any case).

Level.description: The state colour of a number column: ok below `warn`, warn below `critical`, critical above.

when.description: Only rows whose fields have these values (`{"unit": "°C"}`).

Part.description: A part of a stack: a view by name, or a view written in place.

Placed.description: A view in a stack, or on a thread: its name and its parameters.

Action.description:
A button that runs an operation with its normal approval: no confirm for a read, the plan first when the
operation has a dry run, an inline confirm for a change of the session or the workspace, polkit for the machine.

label.description: The words on the button; `{row.field}` and `{item.field}` are a row's and an item's values.

input.description: The operation's input: `{param}`, `{row.field}`, `{item.field}` in strings; a whole `"{item.input}"` is the value.

each.description: A row action: one button per item of this array field of the row.

events.description:
Event kinds after which the view reads its source again; `*` at the end matches any rest
(`code.tests.*`). A view reads again after each `views.save` too.

every.description: Read the source again each this many seconds (live values); a refresh reads the data, never the spec.
